_about: COMBAT [ghosts and apparitions] 10/23 (rule 134, Paolo 10/23: 'like in Battle Brothers, one of the enemies are ghosts and apparitions... it fits our world too good'). The Geist's racial skills, each copied from its wiki page in the library the way weapons.json copies a knife; the fight reads this file (DB.racial). An enemy's skills are listed under by_enemy by its enemies.json id. COMBAT [bestiary] 10/24 adds THE MECHANIC's (the Necromancer's Raise Undead and his rule against casting in melee), THE KIDS' (the Throwing Net) and THE HEAVY's (Line Breaker, Shield Bash), each from its page.

horrific_scream.name: Horrific Scream
horrific_scream.says: Horrific Scream will cause resolve-checks with a range of 3 tiles
horrific_scream.checks_say: Their Horrific Scream causes four morale checks with no modifier.

incorporeal.name: Incorporeal
incorporeal.says: Incorporeal grants +10 Melee Defense and +10 Ranged Defense for each tile range away from a Geist (active at range 2+)

crosses_any_ground.name: Crosses any ground
crosses_any_ground.says: They can traverse steep cliffs (verify). | rule 134(a): 'it fights your men's nerve from range, slips over ground and walls, is fragile up close, drops nothing'

raise_undead.name: Raise Undead
raise_undead.says: Raise Undead will raise any type of wiedergangers and skeletons (with 50% of their Hitpoints) and any dead humans; cannot be used if the target was decapitated or its head was smashed, or if someone is standing on the corpse; can be used 2 times a turn (has unlimited range)
raise_undead.ours: his machines only: a dead hire rising on their side is off for the demo (VIA GROK, GROK_04_CHIP_BODY_OPTIONS, the coordinator's 10/1 sweep E); a killing blow to the head is 'its head was smashed' (the chip is gone)

no_spells_in_melee.name: No spells in melee
no_spells_in_melee.says: They can't cast spells if engaged in melee.

throw_net.name: Throw Net
throw_net.says: Roots a target in place, preventing movement and Rotation | Reduces target's Initiative, Melee Defense, Ranged Defense by 45% | Removing a Throwing Net is based on melee skill and initially has -10 points penalty | Each failed attempt to Break Free or Free Ally will give +10 points to remove the net
throw_net.ours: the roll to break free is made for the netted man at the start of his own turn, with no AP of his own spent (rule 117(b): one clear next thing; the library carries no Break Free page and no AP for it)

line_breaker.name: Line Breaker
line_breaker.says: Line Breaker will knock a target 1 tile back, never misses and the target suffers 10 Fatigue, removes Shieldwall, Spearwall, Riposte when applied (has a range of 1 tile)
line_breaker.nowhere_says: They can't push a brother if there is nowhere to push.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.says: Shield Bash will cause knock back from shields to also inflict 10-25 Damage with 50% Armor Damage in addition to any falling damage and the target gets additional 10Fatigue
shield_bash.ours: the heavy's crash-bar shield is the shield the push comes from
